description: Submit an electronic component RFQ for human sourcing in Shenzhen, China. Use for hard-to-find, obsolete, EOL, spot-market, BOM, or other components requiring China sourcing. Maria Jurk reviews the request. This tool does not claim real-time inventory or fabricate pricing or availability.

email.description: Buyer email address where Maria Jurk can respond to the RFQ.
email.title: Email

manufacturer.description: Component manufacturer or brand, if known. Leave empty when unknown.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

name.description: Name of the buyer or contact person submitting the RFQ.
name.title: Name

notes.description: Additional sourcing requirements such as date code, target price, destination, lead time, packaging, acceptable alternatives, or BOM context.
notes.title: Notes

part_number.description: Exact manufacturer part number or component identifier the buyer needs sourced.
part_number.title: Part Number

quantity.description: Required quantity, including units when useful, for example '500 pcs'.
quantity.title: Quantity

name: submit_component_rfq

error.description: Error message when the RFQ could not be accepted.
error.title: Error

handled_by.description: Human sourcing specialist responsible for reviewing the RFQ.
handled_by.title: Handled By

http_status.description: Upstream HTTP status when the RFQ could not be accepted.
http_status.title: Http Status

location.description: Location of the human sourcing specialist.
location.title: Location

ok.description: Whether the RFQ was accepted successfully.
ok.title: Ok

reference.description: Unique Jurk RFQ reference for the submitted request.
reference.title: Reference

status.description: RFQ processing status, such as rfq_received.
status.title: Status

title: Submit Electronic Component RFQ
